project: Slay the Math: Dungeon of Chance

artifacts.name: Emberheart Pendant
artifacts.effect_ms: Pulihkan 2 HP selepas menang combat.
artifacts.visual: A hanging crimson-orange faceted ember pendant, antique copper-gold flame clasp, strong teardrop silhouette.
artifacts.effect_en: After winning a combat, heal 2 HP.

artifacts.name: Cinder Whetstone
artifacts.effect_ms: Kad Attack pertama setiap giliran mendapat +1 jumlah damage.
artifacts.visual: A dark charcoal oblong sharpening stone in a brushed gunmetal tray, just a narrow restrained orange sharpening seam, gray silhouette.
artifacts.effect_en: Your first Attack each turn deals 1 extra damage.

artifacts.name: Prism Buckler
artifacts.effect_ms: Kad Defend pertama setiap giliran memberikan +2 Block.
artifacts.visual: A small angular silver and ivory shield, dark navy inset panels, one vivid cyan faceted central prism.
artifacts.effect_en: Your first Defend each turn gives 2 extra Block.

artifacts.name: Clairvoyance Lens
artifacts.effect_ms: Dapat +1 Focus pada giliran pertama setiap combat, tertakluk kepada had Focus.
artifacts.visual: An antique silver handheld magnifying lens with a luminous amethyst violet glass disc, short plum wrapped handle, no eye glyph.
artifacts.effect_en: Gain 1 Focus on your first turn of each combat.

artifacts.name: Scholar's Bookmark
artifacts.effect_ms: Draw 1 kad tambahan pada giliran pertama setiap combat.
artifacts.visual: A broad forest-green leather bookmark ribbon, V-cut tail, cream inner strip, muted brass top clip, pale sage tassel. No book.
artifacts.effect_en: Draw 1 extra card on your first turn of each combat.

artifacts.name: Merchant's Seal
artifacts.effect_ms: Diskaun 5% untuk pembelian di Shop.
artifacts.visual: A royal-blue wax seal on two warm cream parchment tails with one antique-gold signet ring leaning over it, diamond imprint without letters.
artifacts.effect_en: Get a 5% discount in the Shop.

artifacts.name: Bronze Guard Pin
artifacts.effect_ms: Dapat 3 Block pada giliran pertama setiap combat.
artifacts.visual: A small broad antique-bronze triangular guard pin with a slate-blue enamel center and chunky clasp, simple physical armor brooch.
artifacts.effect_en: Gain 3 Block on your first turn of each combat.

artifacts.name: Traveler's Ration
artifacts.effect_ms: Apabila diperoleh, +5 Max HP dan pulihkan 5 HP. Digunakan sekali untuk run tersebut.
artifacts.visual: One compact round golden-brown travel bread roll half wrapped in warm cream cloth, tied with a small moss-green cord; readable food-bundle silhouette, no plate.
artifacts.effect_en: When obtained, gain 5 Max HP and heal 5 HP. Once per run.

artifacts.name: Copper Purse
artifacts.effect_ms: Apabila diperoleh, dapat 25 Gold. Digunakan sekali untuk run tersebut.
artifacts.visual: A small honey-tan leather coin pouch with a dark green cord and two large copper coins peeking out of its open top, no printed symbols.
artifacts.effect_en: When obtained, gain 25 Gold. Once per run.

artifacts.name: Ember Quill
artifacts.effect_ms: Selepas memainkan kad Skill pertama setiap combat, draw 1 kad.
artifacts.visual: One curved deep-crimson writing quill with a dark burgundy shaft and a small matte brass nib, one ember-orange highlight, long clear feather silhouette, not on fire.
artifacts.effect_en: After your first Skill each combat, draw 1 card.

artifacts.name: Scribe's Pebble
artifacts.effect_ms: Kali pertama kad milik Alyssa memasuki Exhaust setiap combat, dapat 4 Block.
artifacts.visual: A smooth oval pale-turquoise stone with one deeply inset geometric diamond groove and one small silver corner clasp; physical polished talisman, no letters.
artifacts.effect_en: After your first Exhaust each combat, gain 4 Block.

artifacts.name: Initiate's Ring
artifacts.effect_ms: Selepas memainkan kad Passive pertama setiap combat, dapat 3 Block.
artifacts.visual: One simple chunky dark-silver initiate signet ring with a large oval pale-mint glass stone in a shallow bronze setting, no inscription.
artifacts.effect_en: After your first Passive each combat, gain 3 Block.

artifacts.name: Copper Abacus
artifacts.effect_ms: Selepas memainkan 3 kad dalam satu giliran, dapat +1 Energy. Sekali setiap giliran.
artifacts.visual: A miniature walnut-brown counting frame with copper fittings, three open rods with chunky jade-green and cream beads, slight three-quarter view.
artifacts.effect_en: After 3 played cards in the same turn, gain 1 Energy. Once per turn.

artifacts.name: Twin Sigil Medallion
artifacts.effect_ms: Main sekurang-kurangnya 1 Attack dan 1 Defend dalam giliran sama untuk mendapat 6 Block. Sekali setiap giliran.
artifacts.visual: Two chunky interlocking physical rings, one cobalt-blue enamel with silver edges, one bright silver, turquoise diamond gemstone at overlap; figure-eight silhouette.
artifacts.effect_en: Play at least 1 Attack and 1 Defend in the same turn to gain 6 Block. Once per turn.

artifacts.name: Chance Die
artifacts.effect_ms: Giliran pertama: baling d6 sekali. 1–2: +10 Block; 3–4: draw 2 kad; 5–6: +2 Energy.
artifacts.visual: One chunky clean ivory six-sided die in three-quarter view, three visible faces, regular recessed black round pips and muted dark metal corner caps, no printed numerals.
artifacts.effect_en: On the first turn of each combat, roll a d6 once. 1–2: gain 10 Block. 3–4: draw 2 cards. 5–6: gain 2 Energy.

artifacts.name: Ember Balance
artifacts.effect_ms: Jika sekurang-kurangnya 1 Energy masih berbaki ketika End Turn, dapat 6 Block.
artifacts.visual: A small balanced physical scale made of oxidized verdigris-teal bronze, two shallow suspended bowls each holding small restrained amber ember stones.
artifacts.effect_en: At End Turn, gain 6 Block if you have at least 1 unspent Energy.

artifacts.name: Chainbreaker Clasp
artifacts.effect_ms: Kali pertama kad milik Alyssa memasuki Exhaust setiap giliran, draw 1 kad dan dapat 4 Block.
artifacts.visual: A broken gunmetal-gray iron shackle with pewter clasp and two snapped chain links, a small contained violet/indigo magical crack glow, no flames.
artifacts.effect_en: After your first Exhaust each turn, draw 1 card and gain 4 Block.

artifacts.name: Ashen Phoenix Feather
artifacts.effect_ms: Pulihkan 5 HP selepas menang combat.
artifacts.visual: One curved golden-orange phoenix feather with an ash-white tip and a copper quill, sweeping recognizable feather silhouette, tiny contained amber glint, not a wing or bird.
artifacts.effect_en: After winning a combat, heal 5 HP.

artifacts.name: Rune-smith Tongs
artifacts.effect_ms: Kad Attack pertama setiap giliran mendapat +3 jumlah damage.
artifacts.visual: One pair of chunky dark iron blacksmith tongs at a diagonal gripping a short bright yellow-gold hot metal billet, olive-bronze pivot, clear long V-shaped tool silhouette.
artifacts.effect_en: Your first Attack each turn deals 3 extra damage.

artifacts.name: Sentinel Crest
artifacts.effect_ms: Kad Defend pertama setiap giliran memberikan +6 Block.
artifacts.visual: An ornate sentinel armor crest brooch, broad navy enamel central kite with white-silver geometric wings and one small pale sapphire gem. A physical heraldic armor clasp with an unmistakable wide winged silhouette.
artifacts.effect_en: Your first Defend each turn gives 6 extra Block.

artifacts.name: Mirror Knight's Brooch
artifacts.effect_ms: Kali pertama Block menghalang sepenuhnya damage serangan musuh dalam satu giliran, balas 6 damage kepada penyerang. Sekali setiap giliran.
artifacts.visual: An upright miniature oval mirror brooch in ornate pale-silver armor trim with midnight-navy side fins and pale blue glass reflection, no face, no eye, clear mirror silhouette.
artifacts.effect_en: After an enemy hit is fully blocked, deal 6 retaliation damage to the attacker. Once per turn cycle.

artifacts.name: Rune Bat's Bell
artifacts.effect_ms: Selepas memainkan kad Skill pertama setiap giliran, draw 1 kad.
artifacts.visual: One chunky small dark-violet hanging bell with muted brass rim and top loop, two tiny stylized bat-wing side tabs attached to the bell, small lilac clapper, physical relic rather than a creature.
artifacts.effect_en: After your first Skill each turn, draw 1 card.

artifacts.name: Scholar's Satchel
artifacts.effect_ms: Draw 2 kad tambahan pada giliran pertama setiap combat.
artifacts.visual: A compact deep-teal leather scholar satchel with antique brass buckle and two cream parchment page corners peeking from its top, short curled strap contained close to the bag, no letters.
artifacts.effect_en: Draw 2 extra cards on your first turn of each combat.

artifacts.name: Lantern Keeper's Flask
artifacts.effect_ms: Kali pertama HP berada pada 50% Max HP atau kurang semasa Alyssa masih hidup dalam combat, dapat 12 Block.
artifacts.visual: One squat round amber glass lantern-flask encased in dark forest-green metal ribs with a wide bronze cap and a small contained warm golden light, short top handle, bottle silhouette, no fire plume.
artifacts.effect_en: The first time you have 50% Max HP or less while alive in a combat, gain 12 Block.

artifacts.name: Chain Weaver's Spool
artifacts.effect_ms: Kali pertama kesan kad membuang kad daripada hand ke Discard setiap giliran, draw 1 kad dan dapat 3 Block.
artifacts.visual: One stout walnut wooden spool wound with cobalt-blue enchanted thread, bright pewter end rims, one short curved blue thread end close to spool, tiny silver chain-link charm fixed to the spool. No spider, no scene.
artifacts.effect_en: After the first Discard by a card effect each turn, draw 1 card and gain 3 Block.

artifacts.name: Bram's Contract
artifacts.effect_ms: Diskaun 15% untuk pembelian di Shop.
artifacts.visual: One partially rolled warm ivory parchment contract secured by a deep emerald wax seal and a small copper clasp, broad scroll silhouette, tiny abstract line marks without readable text, no letters.
artifacts.effect_en: Get a 15% discount in the Shop.

artifacts.name: Crimson Sword Charm
artifacts.effect_ms: Dapat +2 Strength pada awal setiap combat.
artifacts.visual: A miniature upright sword-shaped charm with a crimson enamel hilt, antique bronze guard and dark polished steel blade, one small ruby at the pommel and a short top loop, physical amulet no trail.
artifacts.effect_en: Gain 2 Strength at the start of combat.

artifacts.name: Guardian's Armlet
artifacts.effect_ms: Dapat +2 Agility pada awal setiap combat.
artifacts.visual: A broad C-shaped silver forearm cuff with lapis-blue enamel panels, one pale sapphire rectangular gem and ivory geometric edge insets, solid wearable armlet silhouette, no hand or arm.
artifacts.effect_en: Gain 2 Agility at the start of combat.

artifacts.name: Gatekeeper Core
artifacts.effect_ms: Dapat +1 Energy pada awal setiap giliran pemain.
artifacts.visual: A legendary angular ivory-stone and silver mechanical gate core, luminous emerald-green diamond suspended within a broken hexagonal frame, heavy charcoal side brackets, elegant restrained green light.
artifacts.effect_en: Gain 1 extra Energy at the start of each turn.

artifacts.name: Sovereign Grimoire Clasp
artifacts.effect_ms: Mula combat dengan +3 Strength dan +3 Agility. Pada giliran kedua dan seterusnya, tambah +1 kedua-duanya sehingga sumbangan artifak mencapai +6 bagi setiap stat.
artifacts.visual: A legendary physical grimoire fastening clasp, an amethyst-purple faceted diamond held in ornate antique-gold wing-shaped brackets, two heavy small violet-enamel hinged arms and a short silver locking chain. A broad regal book-lock silhouette, no full book, no eye glyph.
artifacts.effect_en: Start each combat with 3 Strength and 3 Agility. From turn 2, gain 1 of each per turn, up to an artifact contribution cap of 6 for each stat.

artifacts.name: Decklord's Hourglass
artifacts.effect_ms: Draw 2 kad tambahan pada awal setiap giliran pemain.
artifacts.visual: A legendary physical hourglass with cobalt-blue crystal endcaps and bright silver architectural struts, clear glass containing flowing pearl-white luminous sand, elegant cyan internal highlights, tall symmetric hourglass silhouette. No floating cards, no separate objects.
artifacts.effect_en: Draw 2 extra cards at the start of each turn.
